name: Waist of Space
source:
Waist of Space is a sci-fi, furry expansion VN centering around a crew of spacers hired to recover the flight logs from an abandoned space frigate. Will they complete their mission, or succumb to the horrors within the derelict ship? Only time will tell...

[From [url=https://red-deer-studios.itch.io/waist-of-space]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Waist of Space》是一部以身体膨胀为主题的科幻兽人视觉小说，围绕一支受雇前往废弃太空护卫舰、回收航行日志的船员小队展开。他们能完成任务，还是会屈服于废舰中的恐怖之物？只有时间会给出答案……

[摘自[url=https://red-deer-studios.itch.io/waist-of-space]Itch.io[/url]]
